stem:
A worker is building toys at a factory. The relationship between the number of hours the employee works, x, and the number of toys the employee builds, y, is represented by the equation y = 9x.
Which graph represents this relationship?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with points (1, 10), (2, 11), (3, 12) with axes labeled Number of Hours Worked (x) and Number of Toys Built (y) going up to 18.

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with points (1, 9), (2, 18), (3, 27) with axes labeled Number of Hours Worked (x) and Number of Toys Built (y) going up to 27.

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with points (6, 1), (18, 2), (24, 3) with axes labeled Number of Hours Worked (x) up to 30 and Number of Toys Built (y) up to 9.

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with points (10, 1), (11, 2), (12, 3) with axes labeled Number of Hours Worked (x) up to 16 and Number of Toys Built (y) up to 9.

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled F, H, G, and J with points plotted as described above.
